description:
Abstract: The web browser has never been more capable, yet modern web development often means hundreds of megabytes of dependencies, layers of abstractions, and an endless stream of security vulnerabilities. But there is another way. By leveraging the browser, embracing web standards, and putting state in the right place, we can create interactive apps that are simpler, more resilient, and built to stand the test of time. This talk explores how Datastar enables a return to web fundamentals without sacrificing performance or user experience.
